newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Q4 GDP growth assumed at zero - stats office.
newsitem.headline: German Q4 GDP growth assumed at zero - stats office.

text.p: German gross domestic product in the fourth quarter was largely unchanged from the previous quarter, the Federal Statistics Office said on Thursday.

"We have almost completely to estimate the fourth quarter but the development of GDP was about unchanged from the third quarter. Seasonally adjusted that means zero," statistics official Wolfgang Strohm told a news conference.
